mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where CPI YoY growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE falls below 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) YoY growth exceeds 3%, the combination signals a potential stagflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST decreases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters and Industrial Production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 1% YoY, the combination signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 negative growth for 2 consecutive quarters and INDPRO YoY decrease > 1%
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 shows negative growth for 2 consecutive quarters and INDPRO decreases by more than 1% YoY.
